name: Mahali's Stronghold
slug: Mahali's stronghold was evacuated after Gerk's doorway opened into its kitchen.
description: Mahali's Stronghold is a known stronghold associated with Mahali and its inhabitants.

log.summary: During this session, Gerk's doorway unexpectedly opened directly into Mahali's kitchen. Because the effects of the doorway were unknown, Mahali and the stronghold's residents evacuated to the tavern as a precaution. The inhabitants may be able to return once the danger from the doorway is resolved.
notes: Gerk's doorway unexpectedly opened directly into Mahali's kitchen.
Mahali and the residents evacuated to the tavern as a precaution because of the unknown effects of the doorway.
The stronghold's inhabitants may be able to return once the danger is resolved.

openQuestions: Will the reality distortion have any lasting effect on the stronghold after the doorway is closed?
